paid_last_friday.why: guesses the usual Friday payday: the last Friday of the month instead of the last Thursday

calendar_month.why: pays each calendar month's shifts, the 1st to the last day, instead of the 23rd of the month before to the 22nd

pension_over_1561.why: off by one: no pension at exactly 1561.00 gross, only above it

paid_on_22nd.why: mixes up the two dates: pays on the 22nd, the look-alike cut-off day, and keeps calendar months
